answerbit_credential_assignments_scope_c.name: answerbit_credential_assignments_scope_ck
answerbit_credential_assignments_scope_c.value: ("answerbit_credential_assignments"."scope_type" = 'team' AND "answerbit_credential_assignments"."brand_id" IS NULL) OR ("answerbit_credential_assignments"."scope_type" = 'brand' AND "answerbit_credential_assignments"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL)

notification_rules_threshold_ck.name: notification_rules_threshold_ck
notification_rules_threshold_ck.value: ("notification_rules"."type" = 'low_credits' and "notification_rules"."threshold" >= 0 and "notification_rules"."brand_id" is null and "notification_rules"."metric" is null and "notification_rules"."window_days" is null) or ("notification_rules"."type" = 'connection_failure' and "notification_rules"."threshold" between 1 and 20 and "notification_rules"."brand_id" is null and "notification_rules"."metric" is null and "notification_rules"."window_days" is null) or ("notification_rules"."type" = 'metric_anomaly' and "notification_rules"."threshold" between 1 and 100 and "notification_rules"."brand_id" is not null and "notification_rules"."metric" is not null and "notification_rules"."window_days" between 1 and 90)

users_agent_validity_type_ck.name: users_agent_validity_type_ck
users_agent_validity_type_ck.value: "users"."account_type" = 'agent' OR ("users"."agent_valid_from" IS NULL AND "users"."agent_expires_at" IS NULL)

users_agent_validity_range_ck.name: users_agent_validity_range_ck
users_agent_validity_range_ck.value: "users"."agent_valid_from" IS NULL OR "users"."agent_expires_at" IS NULL OR "users"."agent_valid_from" < "users"."agent_expires_at"

users_agent_limits_type_ck.name: users_agent_limits_type_ck
users_agent_limits_type_ck.value: "users"."account_type" = 'agent' OR ("users"."agent_enterprise_limit" IS NULL AND "users"."agent_brand_limit" IS NULL AND "users"."agent_answerbit_points_limit" IS NULL)

users_agent_limits_nonnegative_ck.name: users_agent_limits_nonnegative_ck
users_agent_limits_nonnegative_ck.value: ("users"."agent_enterprise_limit" IS NULL OR "users"."agent_enterprise_limit" >= 0) AND ("users"."agent_brand_limit" IS NULL OR "users"."agent_brand_limit" >= 0) AND ("users"."agent_answerbit_points_limit" IS NULL OR "users"."agent_answerbit_points_limit" >= 0)
